values.en: Criterion for a Scalar Product to Vanish

content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(LA.VectorSpace(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Type.annotation(@k, $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Type.annotation(@v, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), Logic.iff(Eq(LA.Smul(k, v), LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), Logic.or(Eq(k, $0$), Eq(v, LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)))))
